disclosures.heading: Important information
disclosures.short_notice: For reflection and study. Not medical, legal or financial advice.
disclosures.general_guidance: Kaalam computes astronomical positions and applies classical Vedic rules to them. The readings that result are offered for reflection and cultural study, not as statements of fact about past or future events.
disclosures.not_professional_advice: Nothing in this material is professional advice. It is not a substitute for a qualified doctor, mental health professional, lawyer, accountant or financial adviser.
disclosures.health: Nothing here diagnoses, treats, cures or predicts any illness or medical condition. If you have a health concern, consult a qualified clinician and follow the treatment they prescribe.
disclosures.remedies: Remedies, fasts, donations and rituals described here are traditional practices offered as cultural information. Following them is voluntary, no outcome is promised, and they must never replace prescribed medical treatment.
disclosures.no_guarantee: No accuracy, outcome or result is guaranteed. Astrological interpretation is not an empirically validated method of prediction.
disclosures.user_responsibility: Every decision you take remains your own. Kaalam and its authors accept no liability for any action taken on the basis of this material.
disclosures.research_only: Market analysis in Kaalam is research tooling for studying historical relationships, published in research mode only.
disclosures.not_investment_advice: Nothing here is investment advice. Kaalam is not a registered investment adviser and offers no personalised financial recommendation.
disclosures.not_trading_advice: Nothing here is trading advice. An association found in historical market data does not establish that it will repeat.
disclosures.not_buy_sell_recommendation: No output is a buy, hold or sell signal. A directional label describes only what the sampled sessions did, never what a market will do.
disclosures.independent_validation_required: Validate any finding independently, against your own data and against a null baseline, before relying on it.
